purpose: Define the single, machine-enforced folder layout for every TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY candidate.

files: mechanism.md            # C01: what the candidate is, in mechanism terms
architecture.md         # C02: how the mechanism is realized (components, geometry, control law)
engineering_spec.md     # C02: engineering tolerances, materials, manufacturing notes
prototype_blueprint.md  # C03: physical / software blueprint for the reference implementation
known_limitations.md    # C09: what the model does NOT capture, approximations, uncertainty

subdirs.name: primary_results/
files: preregistration.json    # C06: pre-registered falsification criterion (timestamped BEFORE result)
result.json             # C07: actual measurement, with seeds, configs, raw output references
raw_outputs/            # C07: full raw outputs (not just summary statistics)

subdirs.name: independent_verification/
files: verification_ledger_entry.json  # C08: preregistration + comparison + verdict
our_output.json                 # C08: our implementation's output on the reference case
independent_output.json         # C08: external solver's output on the same case
comparison.json                 # C08: quantitative comparison + verdict + root cause (if disagreement)
raw_outputs/                    # C08: both runs' full outputs preserved

subdirs.name: comparator/
files: comparator.md          # C04: strongest comparator (named, cited, no strawman)
comparator_model.py    # C04: comparator's reference implementation (or reproduction)
comparator_output.json # C04: comparator's output on the same scenario

subdirs.name: attacks/
files: attack_01_functional_equivalence.md   # C05
attack_02_prior_art.md                # C05
attack_03_mechanism_failure.md        # C05
attack_results.json                  # C05: each attack's verdict

subdirs.name: provenance/
files: ai_loop_provenance.json   # C08 + Article XXXVI §10: full HYPOTHESIS→READY chain
search_provenance.json    # C16: queries → databases → results → exclusions (R274)
constitution_acknowledgment.json  # Article XXXVI acknowledgment

evidence/.required_for_TTP_COMPLETE: all 5 subdirs present with required files

files: value_model.md      # C11 + C12: economic model with sourced inputs + counterfactual
sensitivity.md      # C11: tornado chart + output range
assumptions.json    # C11: all assumptions, each with evidence_tier (MODELLED/PUBLICLY_VERIFIED/BUYER_VERIFIED)
economics/.required_for_TTP_COMPLETE: all 3 files present, every dollar value has evidence_tier

files: prior_art.md          # C16 + C18: closest art + known threats (with full provenance per R274)
technical_delta.md    # C17: what our system adds (technical effect, not patent claim)
know_how.md           # C19: trade-secret components (necessary but not in public artifacts)
counsel_questions.md  # C20: open questions for buyer counsel (NOT advocacy)
differentiation/.required_for_TTP_COMPLETE: all 4 files present, threats disclosed (Article XV)

files: installation.md      # C10: how to install and run the reference implementation
reproduction.md      # C10: how to reproduce the executed result (third-party reproducible)
buyer_protocol.md    # C13: concrete steps a buyer would take to integrate, validate, deploy
raw_data_schema.json # C07 + C10: schema for all raw data inputs and outputs
transfer/.required_for_TTP_COMPLETE: all 4 files present, reproduction.md verified by a competent third party

files: executive_brief.md       # C13 + C14: 1-page brief for buyer executive
integration_case.md      # C13: detailed integration case for buyer archetype
transaction_options.md   # C14: rights, scope, price tiers (R275: rights differentiate price, not evidence)

manifest.json.description: Single source of truth for the candidate's state. Links each artifact by path and SHA-256.

missing_file_rule.statement: A folder with missing files is not a complete TTP. The candidate is NOT TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY.
missing_file_rule.enforcement: Pre-commit hook validates manifest.json against actual files. Mismatch = commit blocked.

R308_baseline_assessment.candidates_with_partial_TTP: P-01, P-04, P-09 (3 of 15; R276 baseline)
